name: Elder Senna
role: Village elder of Millbrook and a voice on its common house panel — listens on her feet, cup set aside, watching your face
appearance: An older woman who stands to listen rather than sits, cup set down and forgotten, eyes on the speaker's face.
voiceHints: Says little until she has heard all of it, then says one thing.
wants: For Millbrook's people to be heard by the panel before the panel decides for them.
fears: The village deciding in a hurry what it cannot undo.
knowledge: Everyone in Millbrook, and which of them the panel has not yet heard

reactsToReputation.any: listens standing, and remembers exactly what you said

questSeeds: Senna holds a key someone left in her keeping
title: Elder of Millbrook
_domainsWhy: the patience of the walled peace, feeling heard aloud, and a village she tends
_levelWhy: §148: the tier is right (a ruling lord, a seated elder), so the level climbs to the tier's floor rather than the tier dropping.
